Job Title

Job Summary
  
  
The Email Security Engineer is responsible for the administration, security, availability, monitoring, and operational management of enterprise email security platforms. The engineer will work closely with Account Security Team, NTT Operations Teams, OEM vendors, and infrastructure teams to resolve technical issues, implement security controls, enforce security policies, and provide operational and security reporting. The role also supports continuous improvement of email security capabilities, threat protection, and service reliability.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Email Security Platform Management
  

* Administer and maintain enterprise email security platforms and services.
* Ensure high availability, performance, and operational health of email security infrastructure.
* Monitor email security gateways, cloud email security solutions, and supporting systems.
* Manage platform configurations, upgrades, patches, and lifecycle activities.
* Support capacity planning, performance tuning, and operational optimization.

Platform Availability Operational Management
  

* Monitor platform availability and service health to ensure compliance with agreed SLAs.
* Investigate service outages, mail flow issues, delivery delays, and system performance concerns.
* Coordinate incident resolution activities across multiple operational teams.
* Support disaster recovery and business continuity processes related to email security platforms.
* Maintain operational runbooks and standard operating procedures.

* Monitor and respond to:
* Phishing attacks
* Business Email Compromise (BEC)
* Malware campaigns
* Spoofing attempts
* Email-borne threats
* Investigate email security incidents and coordinate remediation activities.
* Support implementation of:
* SPF
* DKIM
* DMARC
* Anti-phishing controls
* Email encryption controls
* Analyze email security trends and recommend improvements.

* Review vendor advisories, product updates, and security bulletins.
* Participate in vendor troubleshooting sessions and technical reviews.

* Enforce security policies, standards, and controls as requested by the Account Security Team.
* Implement email security controls in alignment with organizational security requirements.
* Ensure compliance with approved security baselines and governance requirements.
* Support security exception reviews and risk mitigation activities.
* Validate policy compliance across email security environments.

Reporting Metrics
  

* Generate security and operational reports mutually agreed with the Account Team.
* Develop dashboards and metrics related to:
* Email threat activity
* Phishing detection rates
* Malware detection statistics
* Platform availability
* SLA performance
* Incident response metrics
* Mail flow performance
* Present operational and security posture reports to stakeholders.

Continuous Improvement
  

* Identify opportunities to improve email security controls and operational efficiency.
* Support automation initiatives for email threat investigation and response.
* Improve phishing detection and response capabilities.
* Recommend enhancements to platform resilience and monitoring.
* Contribute to Email Security Program maturity initiatives.

title: Vice President, Engineering
description:
**About Us:**

At apexanalytix, we’re lifelong innovators! Since the date of our founding nearly four decades ago we’ve been consistently growing, profitable, and delivering the best procure-to-pay solutions to the world. We’re the perfect balance of established company and start-up. You will find a unique home here.

And you’ll recognize the names of our clients. Most of them are on The Global 2000. They trust us to give them the latest in controls, audit and analytics software every day. Industry analysts consistently rank us as a top supplier management solution, and you’ll be helping build that reputation.

Read more about apexanalytix - https://www.apexanalytix.com/about/

**Job Details**
---------------

**The Role**

apexanalytix is seeking an engineering executive to serve as VP of Engineering, based in the United States, reporting to the Chief Product & Technology Officer (CPTO) and sitting on the CPTO's leadership team. The role leads the engineering behind our two customer journeys, Supplier Journey and Buyer Journey. It is accountable for delivering them predictably, at high quality, and in a way that teams can own and run in production.

We are moving to the product operating model. Product, engineering and design are organized into four persistent trios, each funded against outcome goals: Supplier Journey, Buyer Journey, Data & Intelligence, and Platform. The VP of Engineering leads the Supplier and Buyer engineering leads and the US engineering teams in those journeys. With both journeys in one engineering organization, the moments suppliers and buyers share (onboarding, validation and payment status) have a single engineering owner.

**Quick Take -**

The VP of Engineering is the engineering partner to the VP of Product and the Head of Design in each trio, and works closely with the Head of AI & Data, who leads the Data & Intelligence trio, including the engineering for the data products we sell, machine learning, data science, data engineering and the agent platform. The role also works with the SVP Engineering & Head of India GCC, whose Noida engineers work in these trios; the Chief Architect; the VP Technology Operations; and the Head of GRC. Experience leading engineering for enterprise SaaS products in empowered, outcome-funded teams is required.

**Trusted Advisor**

* Advises the CPTO and the executive team on engineering capacity, delivery risk, technical debt and the engineering investment needed to meet product and revenue goals.
* Brings an honest, data-backed view of feasibility to product discovery and investment decisions, so the company commits to what it can deliver well.
* Represents engineering to clients and partners on complex integrations, escalations and roadmap commitments, alongside Product and Go-to-Market leaders.

**The Work -**

***Engineering for the customer journeys***

* **Journey engineering.** Leads the Supplier Journey and Buyer Journey engineering leads and their teams. Supplier Journey covers onboarding and validation (bank, tax, sanctions), the supplier portal and self-service, and inquiries and payment status. Buyer Journey covers supplier risk and compliance, invoice and payment controls, duplicate and fraud prevention, and Assurance & Recovery.
* **Shared moments.** Owns engineering for the moments suppliers and buyers share, so they work as one workflow seen from two sides, with clear lead and partner teams for each.
* **Agents in the workflow.** Makes sure journey teams build the agent experiences inside their workflows (such as onboarding, inquiry handling and duplicate-payment triage) on the shared building blocks from Data & Intelligence, to the same engineering and production standards as the rest of the product.

***Partnership with Data & Intelligence***

* **Shared building blocks.** Works with the Head of AI & Data so journey teams use the shared data, scores, models and agent building blocks well, through clear, stable interfaces rather than one-off integrations.
* **Workflow data.** Makes sure journey workflows capture clean, well-defined data that Data & Intelligence can use to enrich data products and improve models.
* **Consistent standards.** Agrees with the Head of AI & Data how models and agents move into production in journey workflows, so they meet the same engineering, production and audit standards.

***Delivery and engineering excellence***

* **Empowered teams.** Builds persistent engineering teams that own outcomes with their product and design partners, not tickets handed to them. Engineers join discovery early to test feasibility and shape solutions.
* **Predictable delivery.** Is accountable for predictable, high-quality delivery against the outcomes each trio commits to. Runs the engineering operating cadence with product and design and fixes delivery problems at the root.
* **Quality and practices.** Raises the bar on code quality, automated testing, CI/CD, observability and secure development. Tracks and improves DORA measures, defect escape rate and incident trends. Drives practical, measured adoption of AI-assisted development.
* **Production ownership.** Ensures teams own what they build in production, including on-call, incident response and root-cause follow-through, working with SRE in Technology Operations.
* **Architecture and standards.** Contributes to the global architecture council chaired by the Chief Architect and co-signs standards that affect the journey trios. Makes sure teams follow them and pay down technical debt deliberately.

***Leadership and management***

* **Organization.** Leads engineering leads, managers and senior engineers across the Supplier Journey and Buyer Journey teams. Designs team boundaries around the trios and hires or promotes the leaders needed to run them.
* **Global teams.** Partners with the SVP Engineering & Head of India GCC so that Noida engineers in journey teams work as full members of those teams, with one set of standards and practices.
* **Talent.** Owns hiring, development, career paths and retention for US engineering, including a technical track to staff and principal engineer.
* **Budget and reporting.** Owns the engineering budget for these teams, including headcount, tooling and vendors. Gives the CPTO regular reporting on delivery, quality, reliability and team health, with each metric backed by data that can be re-run.

**First-Year Priorities**

* Organize engineering into persistent teams aligned to the Supplier Journey and Buyer Journey, and appoint or hire the engineering leads to run them.
* Agree first-year outcome goals and engineering plans with product and design leaders for both journey trios.
* Agree with the Head of AI & Data how journey teams use shared data and agent building blocks, and ship at least one agent experience in a journey workflow to production standards.
* Assign a lead team for each supplier–buyer shared moment, and deliver at least one measurable improvement to a shared workflow.
* Set a baseline for delivery predictability, DORA measures, defect escape rate and production incidents, and show measurable improvement against it.
* Make sure every team owns its services in production, with on-call, runbooks and service-level objectives agreed with Technology Operations.
* Establish career ladders and a hiring plan for US engineering, including the technical track.

**Required Skills**

* 15+ years in software engineering, including 7+ years leading engineering organizations of 50+ engineers through managers and directors in enterprise SaaS.
* A proven record of delivering complex B2B products predictably and at high quality, and of turning around delivery or quality problems.
* Experience building integration-heavy, data-intensive workflow products for enterprise clients at scale.
* Experience working in empowered product teams under the product operating model, as an equal partner to product and design in discovery and delivery.
* Strong technical depth in cloud-native SaaS architecture, distributed systems, integration and data-intensive platforms, sufficient to lead design reviews and make sound technical calls.
* Hands-on familiarity with modern engineering practices: CI/CD, automated testing, observability, DevSecOps and AI-assisted development.
* Experience bringing AI and agent capabilities into production workflows with appropriate guardrails and quality measures.
* A track record of hiring, developing and retaining strong engineering leaders and senior engineers.
* Experience leading distributed teams across US and India time zones.
* Experience operating in security- and compliance-regulated environments (for example SOC 1, SOC 2 and ISO 27001).
* Strong executive presence, able to represent engineering credibly to the CPTO, the executive team, clients and, as needed, the Board.

**Preferred Skills**

* Domain experience in procure-to-pay, accounts payable, supplier management, payment fraud prevention, risk or fintech.
* Experience building integrations with ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle or Microsoft Dynamics.
* Experience in a PE-backed or high-growth SaaS company, connecting engineering investment to revenue and margin.

Over the years, we’ve discovered that the most effective and successful associates at apexanalytix are people who have a specific combination of values, skills, and behaviors that we call “The apex Way”. Read more about The apex Way - https://www.apexanalytix.com/careers/

**Benefits**

At apexanalytix we know that our associates are the reason behind our successes. We truly value you as an associate and part of our professional family. Our goal is to offer the very best benefits possible to you and your loved ones. When it comes to benefits, whether for yourself or your family the most important aspect is choice. And we get that. apexanalytix offers competitive benefits for the countries that we serve, in addition to our BeWell@apex initiative that encourages employees’ growth in six key wellness areas: Emotional, Physical, Community, Financial, Social, and Intelligence.

With resources such as a strong Mentor Program, Internal Training Portal, plus Education, Tuition, and Certification Assistance, we provide tools for our associates to grow and develop.

**JOB DESCRIPTION – FIELD OPERATIONS EXECUTIVE (CIVIL SURVEY & DGPS OPERATIONS)**

**Company:** BetterDrones (Knifedge Lab Technologies Pvt. Ltd.)  
**Location:** Noida, Sector 62, Uttar Pradesh  
**Experience:** 3–6 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Travel Requirement:** Extensive travel across India, including remote and difficult terrain

**About BetterDrones**

BetterDrones is a drone intelligence and geospatial technology company specializing in drone inspections, GIS, LiDAR, mapping, surveying, and AI-powered infrastructure inspection solutions.

We work with power utilities, renewable energy companies, EPC contractors, railways, and government organizations to inspect, map, and manage critical infrastructure using advanced drone and geospatial technologies.

Role Overview

We are looking for a hands-on **Field Operations Executive with a Civil Engineering or Surveying background** to manage and execute field survey and infrastructure inspection projects across India.

The role involves managing Surveyor and DGPS (Differential Global Positioning System) teams, coordinating field activities, monitoring survey quality, handling client communication, and ensuring timely project execution.

**This is a demanding, field-intensive position — not a desk-based operations or coordination job.** Project locations may include difficult terrain, uneven ground, remote areas, long walking routes, and sites with limited accessibility. Candidates must be prepared to work in challenging field conditions and stay at project locations for extended periods.

We are particularly interested in professionals who have worked as Surveyors, DGPS Surveyors, Survey Engineers, or Civil Site Engineers and are ready to take ownership of teams, clients, and end-to-end field execution.

Key Responsibilities1. Field Survey & Project Execution

* Plan, coordinate, and execute field surveying, DGPS, mapping, and infrastructure inspection projects.
* Understand project requirements, survey methodology, site conditions, manpower needs, and equipment requirements before deployment.
* Monitor field progress and ensure survey activities are completed as per project specifications and timelines.
* Visit project sites and actively supervise field execution whenever required.
* Ensure teams are prepared to work in challenging terrain, remote locations, and physically demanding field conditions.

2. Surveyor & DGPS Team Management

* Lead and manage Surveyors, DGPS Surveyors, field engineers, and other deployed personnel.
* Allocate work, plan daily routes, monitor productivity, and ensure adequate field coverage.
* Verify that teams understand survey instructions, coordinates, benchmarks, data collection requirements, and project deliverables.
* Resolve field-level challenges related to manpower, equipment, access, productivity, and survey execution.
* Maintain team discipline, accountability, attendance, and adherence to company policies.

3. Client Coordination & Site Management

* Act as the primary point of contact for clients during field execution.
* Coordinate site access, survey requirements, permissions, daily progress, and project schedules.
* Communicate technical and operational issues clearly and professionally.
* Handle client queries, field-level escalations, and execution-related concerns.
* Provide regular progress updates and ensure client expectations are aligned with actual site conditions and project timelines.

4. Survey Quality & Technical Coordination

* Review survey records, field measurements, DGPS observations, coordinates, and daily field reports.
* Ensure compliance with project specifications, survey procedures, and required accuracy standards.
* Coordinate with GIS, data processing, and project teams for data transfer, validation, and final deliverables.
* Identify gaps, errors, and incomplete field data and arrange corrective action.
* Maintain proper documentation and ensure data completeness before project closure.

5. Planning, Logistics & Equipment Management

* Plan manpower deployment, travel, accommodation, local transportation, and field logistics.
* Coordinate the movement and availability of DGPS equipment, GNSS receivers, survey instruments, drones, batteries, and accessories as applicable.
* Ensure equipment is maintained, handled, and used correctly.
* Anticipate operational risks and arrange resources to minimize downtime and project delays.

6. Reporting & Performance Monitoring

* Prepare daily progress reports, project trackers, manpower reports, and field status updates.
* Monitor project timelines, team productivity, survey coverage, data quality, and pending activities.
* Escalate resource shortages, technical issues, and schedule risks promptly.
* Coordinate with management and internal departments to ensure timely project completion.

Required Experience & QualificationsEssential Requirements

* 3–6 years of experience in civil surveying, DGPS/GNSS surveying, land surveying, infrastructure projects, or field operations.
* Bachelor's degree or diploma in Civil Engineering, Surveying, Geomatics, or a related technical discipline.
* Practical understanding of field survey execution, survey instruments, site measurements, and survey documentation.
* Experience managing or coordinating field teams, preferably Surveyor and DGPS teams.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to manage client interactions professionally.
* Ability to plan field activities, resolve on-site problems, and manage project deadlines.
* Working knowledge of MS Excel, reporting, and project documentation.
* Willingness and physical readiness to work in demanding field conditions and travel extensively across India.

Preferred Experience

* Power transmission line and distribution network surveys.
* Transmission line route surveys and corridor mapping.
* DGPS, GNSS, RTK/PPK, Total Station, Auto Level, or similar surveying workflows.
* Railway, highway, solar, industrial, and other infrastructure surveys.
* LiDAR surveys, drone mapping, and geospatial data collection.
* Experience coordinating with government departments, power utilities, EPC contractors, and infrastructure clients.
* Hands-on experience as a Surveyor or Survey Engineer with subsequent team-management responsibilities.

Field Conditions — Please Read Before Applying

Candidates must understand the practical demands of this role:

* Projects may be located in remote, hilly, uneven, forested, rural, or otherwise difficult-to-access areas, depending on the assignment.
* Fieldwork may involve extensive walking, long outdoor working hours, changing weather, and physically demanding site conditions.
* Some projects require extended stays away from Noida, with travel schedules determined by operational requirements.
* The role requires active supervision of Surveyor and DGPS teams, not merely assigning tasks from the office.
* Candidates must be comfortable handling field personnel, resolving site-level issues, and communicating with clients under pressure.
* Work conditions vary by project, and candidates should be prepared for both relatively accessible sites and challenging terrain.

**Please apply only if you are genuinely comfortable with the field requirements and nationwide travel.**

Why Join BetterDrones?

* Work on large-scale power and infrastructure surveying and inspection projects.
* Gain exposure to DGPS, GIS, LiDAR, drone mapping, and advanced geospatial technologies.
* Work with experienced professionals and enterprise infrastructure clients.
* Develop leadership experience in field operations and project execution.
* Build a career in the growing drone and geospatial technology industry.

Who Should Apply?

Civil Engineers, Surveyors, DGPS Surveyors, Survey Engineers, and field professionals who combine **practical surveying knowledge, team-management ability, strong client communication, and a willingness to work in challenging field conditions**.

Candidates with only office-based coordination experience and no relevant field or surveying exposure may not be suitable for this position.

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance

Application Question(s):

* How many years of hands-on experience do you have in Civil Surveying, DGPS/GNSS Surveying, Land Surveying, or Infrastructure Field Operations? Briefly describe your experience.
* Which surveying instruments have you personally operated or used in field projects? Mention your practical experience with DGPS/GNSS, RTK/PPK, Total Station, Auto Level, or other survey equipment.
* Describe your experience managing Surveyors, DGPS Surveyors, or field survey teams. How many people have you managed, and what were your responsibilities?
* This role involves extensive walking, uneven terrain, remote locations, long outdoor working hours, and physically demanding field conditions. Are you comfortable performing these duties as required? Please explain any relevant field experience.
* Are you willing to travel extensively across India and stay at remote project locations for extended periods according to project requirements? Please confirm clearly.
* Describe a situation where you directly coordinated with a client or site representative during a survey or infrastructure project. What issue arose, and how did you resolve it?
* Our budget for this position is ₹3 LPA to ₹4.2 LPA, depending on experience and suitability. Are you comfortable with this salary range? Please mention your current CTC and expected CTC.
* We are looking for immediate joiners. If selected, how soon can you join? Please mention your current notice period and the earliest confirmed joining date.

Job Description – Senior Software Tester

Job Title: Senior Software Tester / Senior QA Engineer  
Experience: 7–10+ years

Job location- NCR  
Job Type: Full-time  
Department: Quality Assurance / Software Testing

1. Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Senior Software Tester Senior Tester with hands-on testing expertise, client-facing responsibilities, and team management capabilities. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in test planning, test design, test execution, defect management, and automation framework development, along with the ability to coordinate testing activities across cross-functional teams.

The candidate should demonstrate strong analytical and problem-solving skills, ownership of testing deliverables, and the ability to work effectively in an Agile environment while contributing to continuous improvement in QA processes.

2. Key Responsibilities

Test Planning and Execution

* Analyse business requirements, functional specifications, and user stories to identify test scenarios and testing scope.
* Prepare and maintain test plans, test scenarios, test cases, test data, and traceability matrices.
* Perform functional, regression, integration, system, end-to-end, and exploratory testing.
* Execute smoke, sanity, and release validation testing across different environments.
* Identify gaps in requirements and collaborate with Business Analysts, developers, and stakeholders to clarify expectations.
* Demonstrate strong client-handling skills, including regular communication with clients, understanding business expectations, providing testing updates, addressing concerns, and managing expectations effectively.
* Manage and coordinate the testing team, including task allocation, workload prioritisation, progress monitoring, review of testing deliverables, and ensuring timely completion of assigned activities.
* Proactively identify and communicate testing risks, dependencies, blockers, and potential delivery impacts to relevant stakeholders.
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously, effectively prioritising testing activities, allocating time and resources, and meeting project milestones and deadlines without compromising quality.
* Ensure adequate test coverage and quality standards are maintained throughout the software development lifecycle.

Automation Testing

* Design, develop, execute, and maintain automated test scripts using frameworks and tools such as Selenium, or Playwright.
* Identify suitable test cases for automation and contribute to automation strategy and framework improvements.
* Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines to support continuous testing.
* Analyse automation failures, troubleshoot issues, and distinguish between application defects, script failures, and environment-related issues.
* Maintain reusable automation components and ensure scripts remain reliable, scalable, and maintainable.
* Evaluate opportunities to improve testing efficiency through automation and AI-assisted testing tools.

Defect Management

* Identify, document, prioritise, and track defects throughout the defect lifecycle.
* Work closely with developers and business stakeholders to investigate issues and validate fixes.
* Perform retesting and regression testing to ensure defects are resolved without introducing new issues.
* Provide clear defect reports with reproduction steps, test evidence, expected results, and actual results.
* Monitor defect trends and communicate quality risks, blockers, and dependencies proactively.

Team Coordination and Stakeholder Management

* Coordinate testing activities across team members, projects, and multiple applications.
* Collaborate with Business Analysts, developers, product owners, SMEs, and business users.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Provide regular updates on testing progress, execution status, defects, risks, and release readiness.
* Support UAT activities and coordinate with business users to validate business requirements.
* Mentor junior testers, review test cases and automation scripts, and share testing best practices.
* Take ownership of assigned testing deliverables and ensure timely completion of testing activities.

Reporting and Continuous Improvement

* Prepare test execution reports, defect summaries, test completion reports, and quality dashboards.
* Maintain testing artefacts and evidence in test management and project tracking tools.
* Identify process improvements to enhance test coverage, productivity, and release quality.
* Contribute to risk-based testing, test estimation, resource planning, and continuous QA improvement initiatives.
* Support production releases through smoke testing, sanity checks, and post-deployment validation.

3. Required Technical Skills

* Manual Testing: Strong knowledge of functional, regression, integration, system, end-to-end, and exploratory testing.
* Automation Testing: Hands-on experience Selenium, Playwright, or equivalent automation tools.
* Test Management: Experience with Azure DevOps, Jira, or similar test management and defect tracking tools.
* API Testing: Knowledge of REST APIs, request/response validation, and tools such as Postman.
* Database Testing: Ability to write SQL queries and validate backend data.
* CI/CD: Understanding of automated test execution within build and deployment pipelines.
* Methodologies: Strong understanding of SDLC, STLC, Agile, and Scrum practices.
* Documentation: Ability to create and maintain test plans, test cases, test reports, and traceability documentation.
* Version Control: Familiarity with Git or equivalent version control tools.

4. Required Experience and Competencies

* 7–10+ years of experience in software testing, including both manual and automation testing.
* Proven experience testing enterprise web-based applications.
* Experience working in Agile delivery teams and managing testing activities across multiple workstreams.
* Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and problem-solving capabilities.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to manage priorities, dependencies, risks, and deadlines effectively.
* Strong ownership, accountability, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with distributed teams.
* Experience mentoring team members and supporting knowledge transfer.

5. Desirable Skills

* Experience in telecom, asset management, waste management, hospitality, or other enterprise business domains.
* Exposure to mobile application testing on Android and iOS.
* Experience with performance testing tools such as JMeter.
* Familiarity with cloud-based applications and enterprise integrations.
* Knowledge of AI-assisted testing, generative AI, AI agent validation, and intelligent test automation.
* Exposure to Business Analysis activities, including requirement reviews, process understanding, and acceptance criteria validation.

6. Key Success Criteria

The Senior Software Tester will be expected to:

* Deliver comprehensive test coverage aligned with business requirements.
* Identify critical defects early and minimise production issues.
* Maintain reliable and effective automation suites.
* Provide transparent and timely reporting on testing progress and quality risks.
* Coordinate effectively with technical and business stakeholders.
* Contribute to continuous improvement in testing practices and team capability.
* Support high-quality, predictable, and timely software releases.

* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

* how much experience do you have in automation testing?

This is a builder's role, not an audit role. You will design security into our architecture, our delivery pipeline and our AI features, and lead the team that keeps it there. Compliance, certifications and penetration testing are part of the remit, but they are outcomes of a well-run program, not the program itself.

We want someone who has already thought hard about what changes when a product talks to a model: prompt injection and hijacking, data leaking through model context, agents with too much authority, and attackers who now use AI too.

**Layer**

Supply-chain integrity, runtime detection, least-privilege workloads

  

**Edge**

CDNs, WAF, bot detection agents

Tuned defences against scraping, credential stuffing and AI-driven bots

  

**APIs**

Public and partner APIs behind API protection

Discovery, schema enforcement, abuse and BOLA/BFLA detection

  

**Applications**

Modern web front ends and backend services

Secure-by-default frameworks and paved roads for engineers

  

**AI**

Extensive use of AI and LLMs in client-facing features

An LLM threat model, guardrails, evals and monitoring in production

**Job Description**
-------------------

**ABOUT THIS TEAM**

BOLD Platform services team design, creates, manage and maintains the highly scalable and distributed services for the wider use of web and mobile product applications/portals/websites. The current list of services is based on Microservices architecture whose domain ranges from visitor tracking, User profiles, authentication, content and payments.

Platform team uses state of the art modern technologies like .Net framework, Python, Java, SQL Server, My SQL, Graph DB, SOLR, and a lot of other tools & technologies serving millions of users with hundreds of million transactions everyday through a scalable and fault tolerant architecture.

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

* **AI and LLM security:** Own the threat model for every AI/LLM-powered feature, covering prompt injection and prompt hijacking (direct and indirect), jailbreaks, system-prompt and data leakage, insecure output handling, excessive agency in tool-calling, and model denial-of-wallet.
* **AI assurance:** Build adversarial evals and red-team exercises for AI features into the release process, with production monitoring for abuse and drift. Govern internal AI use, including coding assistants, agents with repo or cloud access, plugin integrations and shadow AI.
* **Multicloud security:** Set a unified security architecture across AWS and Azure: identity federation and guardrail policies. Harden Kubernetes with admission control, network policy, workload identity and runtime threat detection.
* **Edge defences and real-time tuning:** Own edge security across every client-facing product, working with Architecture and Technical Operations on real-time tuning of DDoS mitigation thresholds, rate limits, bot-score and challenge thresholds, and WAF rule sensitivity, balancing attacks blocked against false positives for real customers.
* **API security:** Run an API security program covering inventory of every endpoint, authentication and authorization patterns, rate limiting and abuse detection.

description:
About Signant Health
  
At Signant Health, we help bring life\-changing treatments to patients faster. We are a global evidence generation company that supports clinical trials with smart technology, scientific expertise, and hands\-on operational support — so better data leads to better decisions in healthcare. We embrace AI and advanced technologies to enhance every aspect of what we do, from data analysis to operational efficiency.
  
Our teams work at the intersection of science, technology, and patient experience, delivering digital solutions powered by AI innovation that make clinical trials more efficient, more accurate, and more accessible around the world. Trusted by leading pharmaceutical companies and CROs, our platforms and services support studies across more than 90 countries and have contributed to hundreds of new drug approvals.
  
If you are motivated by meaningful work, global impact, and innovation in clinical research and digital health — including the opportunity to work with cutting\-edge AI technologies — you will find purpose and opportunity at Signant Health.
  
  

About the Role
  
The IT Applications Engineer is a generalist engineering and support role responsible for the day\-to\-day administration, configuration, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of Signant Health's core business applications. The role carries particular depth in NetSuite, Microsoft 365, Box, and Atlassian (Jira, Jira Service Management, and Confluence), while also supporting the broader enterprise application portfolio as needed.
  
This is a hands\-on, individual\-contributor role that blends technical engineering — configuration, scripting, integrations, automations, and upgrades — with day\-to\-day operational support — tickets, incidents, and user requests. The IT Applications Engineer is a trusted first\- and second\-line point of contact for application issues, and is equally comfortable delivering enhancements and automations that improve reliability and reduce manual effort across the application landscape. Where the IT Application Operations Manager sets direction and leads the team, this role does the technical and support work directly, partnering closely with the Service Operations, Infrastructure Operations, and Security Operations teams.
  
  

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES \- Function
  
1\. Application Administration \& Configuration — Own day\-to\-day administration and configuration of NetSuite, Microsoft 365 (Exchange Online, SharePoint/OneDrive, Teams, Entra ID), Box, and Atlassian (Jira, JSM, Confluence), plus other assigned enterprise applications, including user provisioning, permissions, and platform settings.
  
2\. Technical Support \& Incident Resolution — Act as a key point of escalation for tier 2/3 application support tickets, diagnosing and resolving issues across the supported application stack and coordinating with vendors and other IT teams as needed.
  
3\. Engineering \& Customization — Build and maintain customizations to meet business requirements — including SuiteScript/SuiteFlow (NetSuite), Power Automate/Graph API automations (Microsoft 365\), workflow and scripting configuration (Atlassian), and equivalent customizations for other supported applications.
  
4\. Integrations \& Automation — Develop and support integrations between applications using APIs, webhooks, and low\-code/iPaaS tooling, building automations that reduce manual effort and improve reliability.
  
5\. Change, Release \& Patch Management — Plan, test, and execute upgrades, patches, and configuration changes across supported applications, minimizing disruption to the business.
  
6\. Security \& Compliance — Apply access control, licensing, and data\-handling practices aligned with company security policy and relevant regulatory and quality requirements.
  
7\. Monitoring \& Continuous Improvement — Monitor application health, usage, and performance; proactively identify issues and recommend and implement improvements.
  
8\. Vendor \& Stakeholder Coordination — Liaise with software vendors and business stakeholders on support cases, licensing, and roadmap requests for supported platforms.
  
9\. Documentation \& Knowledge Sharing — Maintain runbooks, configuration standards, and knowledge base articles; participate in knowledge transfer and cross\-training to build coverage across the application portfolio.
  
10\. AI \& Automation Adoption — Identify and pilot opportunities to apply AI\-assisted tooling, agents, and low\-code automation to improve support efficiency and business workflows.
  
11\. Roadmap Support — Contribute to application\-specific roadmaps for releases, improvements, and vendor\-provided enhancements, in partnership with the IT Application Operations Manager.
  
  

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS \& ATTRIBUTES
  
  

**Essential:**  

1\. NetSuite — Administration and configuration; SuiteScript 2\.x and SuiteFlow; saved searches/SuiteAnalytics; SuiteTalk and REST API integrations.
  
2\. Microsoft 365 — Administration of Exchange Online, SharePoint/OneDrive, Teams, and Entra ID (Azure AD); familiarity with Intune and the Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps).
  
3\. Box — Content management administration, permissions and governance, and API\-based integrations.
  
4\. Atlassian — Administration and configuration of Jira, Jira Service Management, and Confluence, including workflow design and scripting (e.g., ScriptRunner).
  
5\. APIs \& Integrations — Working knowledge of REST APIs, webhooks, and low\-code/iPaaS tools (e.g., Power Automate, N8N, Boomi) for connecting applications.
  
6\. Scripting \& Automation — Proficiency in at least one scripting language (JavaScript, PowerShell, or Python) for customization, troubleshooting, and automation.
  
7\. Application Lifecycle Management — Experience with patching, upgrades, testing, and change management for SaaS/cloud and on\-premise applications.
  
8\. Security \& Compliance Awareness — Understanding of access management, data protection, and relevant compliance frameworks (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, and GxP where applicable).
  
9\. ITSM \& Monitoring Tools — Familiarity with ticketing/ITSM tooling (e.g., Jira Service Management) and application monitoring/observability tools.
  
  

**Desirable:**  

1\. Clear and effective communication with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
  
2\. Strong troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis skills.
  
3\. Good organizational and time\-management skills across competing priorities.
  
4\. Ability to document clearly and concisely for varied audiences.
  
5\. Adaptability and resilience amid changing priorities and technologies.
  
6\. Effective cross\-team collaboration with Infrastructure, Security, Automation, and Business Analyst teams.
  
  

Why Signant Health?
  
At Signant Health, your work has real impact. Everything we build, support, and deliver helps advance clinical research and bring new treatments to patients faster — improving lives around the world. Our teams combine science, technology, and operational expertise to solve complex clinical trial challenges, and every role contributes to that mission.
  
  

We offer a collaborative, global environment where you can grow your career while working alongside experts across clinical, technology, data, and operations, with opportunities to learn, take ownership, and drive meaningful innovation — not just maintain the status quo.
  
  

If you are looking for purpose\-driven work, smart colleagues, and the opportunity to help shape the future of clinical research and digital health, Signant Health is the place to do it.
